question: Who among the following broke the national under-20 record in the 10,000 m race walk in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Amit Khatri.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Amit Khatri won a silver in the men's **10,000m race walk **event to clinch India's second medal at the World U-20
